plain: An officer who collects taxes on goods made or sold.

webster.text: An officer who inspects commodities and rates the excise duty on them.

example.quote: Suppose an exciseman will demand leave to enter your cellar, or house, by virtue of his office ; perhaps he may call on the militia to enable him to go.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
